title: A union bound for two-stage Bernoulli restrictions
statement:
Fix $n$, and let $p,q$ be real parameters with $0\le p\le 1$ and $0\le q\le 1$. For a parameter $r$ write $w_r(\rho)$ for the Bernoulli weight of a restriction $\rho$ on $n$ variables at parameter $r$, and write $\bbP_r[E]$ for the Bernoulli event probability of a predicate $E$ on restrictions at parameter $r$. Then for any two predicates $A$ and $B$ on restrictions of $n$ variables,
\[
\sum_{\rho_1} w_p(\rho_1)\,\bbP_q\!\big[\,\rho_2 \mapsto A(\rho_1)\lor B(\rho_2)\,\big]
\;\le\; \bbP_p[A] + \bbP_q[B],
\]
where the inner sum ranges over all restrictions $\rho_1$ on $n$ variables and, for each fixed $\rho_1$, the predicate $\rho_2 \mapsto A(\rho_1)\lor B(\rho_2)$ holds at a second-stage restriction $\rho_2$ exactly when $A$ holds at $\rho_1$ or $B$ holds at $\rho_2$.
hypotheses_covered: A is a (decidable) predicate on restrictions of n variables
B is a (decidable) predicate on restrictions of n variables
replaced:
For $0\le p\le 1$ and $0\le q\le 1$, and decidable events $A,B$ on restrictions,
\[
\sum_{\rho_1}\mathrm{bernoulliRestrWeight}\,p\,\rho_1\cdot
\mathrm{bernoulliRestrProb}\,q\,(A(\rho_1)\vee B(\rho_2))
\le \mathrm{bernoulliRestrProb}\,p\,A + \mathrm{bernoulliRestrProb}\,q\,B,
\]
where the inner event combines $A$ on the first-stage restriction with $B$ on the
second-stage restriction. This bounds the failure of a composed two-stage
Bernoulli restriction by the sum of the two individual stage probabilities.
